description: This file contains logging methods for the ActivationRepartitioner class within the Orleans runtime project. It defines partial methods for debug, trace, warning, and error log messages related to activation repartitioning and exchange protocols.

classes.name: ActivationRepartitioner
classes.description: Partial class responsible for activation repartitioning in Orleans, with logging methods for various repartitioning events.

methods.name: LogPeriodicallyInvokeProtocol
methods.description: Logs the initiation of the periodic exchange protocol with timing details.

methods.name: LogSingleSiloCluster
methods.description: Logs a message indicating that activation repartitioning is waiting for more silos to join the cluster.

methods.name: LogExchangeSetIsEmpty
methods.description: Logs that the exchange set for a candidate silo is empty and the system will attempt the next candidate.

methods.name: LogBeginningProtocol
methods.description: Logs the start of an exchange protocol between this silo and a candidate silo.

methods.name: LogExchangedRecently
methods.description: Logs that an exchange request was received but the silo has been recently involved in another exchange.

methods.name: LogExchangedRecentlyResponse
methods.description: Logs that an exchange request was rejected because the candidate was recently involved in another exchange.

methods.name: LogMutualExchangeAttempt
methods.description: Logs that an exchange request from a silo is rejected because a mutual exchange is already in progress.

methods.name: LogMutualExchangeAttemptResponse
methods.description: Logs that an exchange request was superseded by a mutual exchange attempt.

methods.name: LogProtocolFinalized
methods.description: Logs the completion of an exchange protocol, indicating the number of activations migrated.

methods.name: LogProtocolFinalizedTrace
methods.description: Trace-level log for detailed information about activation migration during protocol finalization.

methods.name: LogErrorOnProtocolExecution
methods.description: Logs an error that occurred during the execution of an exchange request protocol.

methods.name: LogErrorOnMigratingActivations
methods.description: Logs an error encountered during migration of activation sets.

methods.name: LogReceivedExchangeRequest
methods.description: Logs when an exchange request is received, including set and activation counts.

methods.name: LogImbalance
methods.description: Logs the current imbalance of activations between silos.

methods.name: LogTransferSetComputed
methods.description: Logs the time taken to compute a transfer set and the anticipated post-transfer imbalance.

methods.name: LogErrorAcceptingExchangeRequest
methods.description: Logs an error encountered while accepting an exchange request.

methods.name: LogCoolingDown
methods.description: Logs the duration of cooldown before starting another exchange protocol.

methods.name: LogAddingAnchoredGrains
methods.description: Logs the addition of newly anchored grains to a silo's set.

methods.name: LogComputedCandidateSets
methods.description: Logs the computation time for candidate sets.

methods.name: LogComputedCandidateHeaps
methods.description: Logs the creation time for candidate heaps.
